ScheduleConfig.description:
Schedule configuration from the frontend widget.
Fields accept Union[int, str] to support drag-and-drop references like
{{nodeId.values.field}} which get resolved at configuration time.

daysOfWeek.description: Days of week to run on (0=Sunday … 6=Saturday); empty = every day. Supported for seconds/minutes/hours intervals and daily schedules.
daysOfWeek.title: Daysofweek

windowStart.description: Part-of-day start as 24-hour "HH:MM" in the schedule timezone (e.g. "09:00"). Set together with windowEnd; interval frequencies only.
windowStart.title: Windowstart

windowEnd.description: Part-of-day end as 24-hour "HH:MM", inclusive — a run landing exactly on it fires (e.g. "18:00" runs the 6:00 PM tick).
windowEnd.title: Windowend

monthDayStart.description: Part-of-month start day (1-31), inclusive. Set together with monthDayEnd; a start after the end wraps around month end (25→5 = the 25th through the 5th).
monthDayStart.title: Monthdaystart

monthStart.description: Part-of-year start month (1=January … 12=December), inclusive. Set together with monthEnd; a start after the end wraps around the new year (11→2 = November through February).
monthStart.title: Monthstart

ScheduleConfig.title: ScheduleConfig

SuprSendAPIKeyCredential.title: SuprSend API Key
SuprSendAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: In your SuprSend workspace, open Developers → API Keys and paste an API key. Choose a key with the permissions your actions need. NoClick verifies it by reading this workspace's subscriber lists.

list_id.description: Unique string identifier of the list to which user needs to be updated
list_id.title: List id

distinct_ids_json.description: Array of subscriber_ids, uniquely identifying the subscribers to be added to the list.
distinct_ids_json.title: Distinct ids

execution_id.description: Unique execution identifier of the workflow run to cancel. You can find this in the workflow logs on the SuprSend dashboard.
execution_id.title: Execution id

recipients_json.description: List of recipient `distinct_id`s whose workflow runs should be cancelled.
recipients_json.title: Recipients

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key that was passed when triggering the workflow. Use this to cancel a specific workflow triggered with a known idempotency key.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency key

workflow.description: Slug of the workflow whose runs should be cancelled.
workflow.title: Workflow

list_id.description: Unique string identifier of the list. Add an id which defines the type of users who are part of the list. Allowed characters: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores.
list_id.title: List id

list_name.description: Name of the List. Add a name which defines the type of users in the list.
list_name.title: List name

list_description.description: Brief description of the list and the type of users in it.
list_description.title: List description

list_type.description: Type of the list. Use `dynamic_list` to create a [Segment List](/docs/segment-lists) whose membership is driven by a SQL query. Defaults to `static_list`.
list_type.title: List type

query.description: SQL query defining the segment. **Needed for a `dynamic_list` to sync** — if omitted, the list is created but its segment sync stays disabled. Must return a `distinct_id` column and reference only the `users` and `events` tables. See the [Segment Lists doc](/docs/segment-lists) for the full dialect reference.
query.title: Query

is_enabled.description: Only applies to `dynamic_list`. When `true`, the segment starts syncing immediately after create. When `false`, the query is saved but the segment does not refresh until you enable it.
is_enabled.title: Is enabled

distinct_id.description: Unique identifier of the user in your system
distinct_id.title: Distinct id

list_id.description: Unique string identifier of the list.
list_id.title: List id

template_slug.description: Template group slug you want to fetch content details. You'll get the template slug by clicking on copy button next to template group name on SuprSend dashboard -> template details page.
template_slug.title: Template slug

tenant_id.description: unique identifier of the tenant you want to get the details for
tenant_id.title: Tenant id

distinct_id.description: Unique identifier of the user in your system
distinct_id.title: Distinct id

distinct_id.description: distinct_id of the user whose preferences should be fetched
distinct_id.title: Distinct id

tenant_id.description: to fetch user preferences for a particular tenant
tenant_id.title: Tenant id

show_opt_out_channels.description: set this flag to `true` if you want to fetch channel list for opt-out categories.
show_opt_out_channels.title: Show opt out channels

tags.title: Tags

locale.description:
Locale code (e.g., `es`, `fr`, `es-AR`) to fetch preference translations in user's locale. When provided, the API looks for category and section names and descriptions in the respective locale file.
If a translation is missing for the requested locale, the system automatically falls back in this order: `locale-region` (e.g., `es-AR`) → `locale` (e.g., `es`) → `en` (English - always available).
locale.title: Locale

list_id.description: The list_id of your subscriber list
list_id.title: List id

before.description: the 'id' before which the results need to be fetched
before.title: Before

after.description: the 'id' after which the results need to be fetched
after.title: After

sort.description: the sort order, ascending or descending, here it's decided by 'id': ascending and '-id': descending
sort.title: Sort

limit.description: number of results to be returned in API response
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: starting position of the lists to return
offset.title: Offset

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return per page. Defaults to `10`, maximum is `1000` (`20` when `include_content=true`). Larger values are capped to the maximum.
limit.title: Limit

after.description: Cursor for forward pagination - pass the `meta.after` value from a previous response to fetch the next page of older messages. Treat this value as an opaque cursor - do not parse, validate, or assume any format for it. **Takes precedence over `before` when both are set** (`before` is silently ignored).
after.title: After

before.description: Cursor for backward pagination - pass the `meta.before` value from a previous response to fetch the previous page of newer messages. Treat this value as an opaque cursor - do not parse, validate, or assume any format for it. Ignored when `after` is also set.
before.title: Before

recipient_ids_json.description: Filter by one or more recipient `distinct_id`s (OR-ed). Repeat the param for each value, e.g. `?recipient_id[]=user_123&recipient_id[]=user_456`.
recipient_ids_json.title: Recipient ids

categorys_json.description: Filter by one or more notification categories (OR-ed). Repeat the param for each value, e.g. `?category[]=transactional&category[]=promotional`.
categorys_json.title: Categorys

created_at_gte.description: RFC3339 timestamp lower bound (inclusive). Compared against the `created_at` column which has **second precision** - sub-second components in the filter value are effectively truncated. Example: `2026-04-26T21:34:33Z`.
created_at_gte.title: Created at gte

created_at_lte.description: RFC3339 timestamp upper bound (inclusive). Same second-precision caveat as `created_at_gte`. Must be `>= created_at_gte` when both are set.
created_at_lte.title: Created at lte

workflow_slug.description: Filter messages triggered from a specific workflow.
workflow_slug.title: Workflow slug

idempotency_key.description: Filter by the idempotency key associated with the message at trigger time.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency key

tenant_id.description: Filter messages belonging to a specific tenant.
tenant_id.title: Tenant id

is_campaign.description: Set `true` to return only messages sent as part of a broadcast/campaign.
is_campaign.title: Is campaign

include_content.description: Set `true` to include the rendered message content in each result object. When `false` (default), the `content` key is omitted from the response to keep payloads lightweight.
include_content.title: Include content

has_tags_any.description: comma separated string of tag names attached to the template. Returns templates that have any of the given tags.
has_tags_any.title: Has tags any

has_channels_any.description: comma separated string of channels. Returns templates which has any of the channels present from the channel string. Use these keys for channels - `email`, `sms`, `whatsapp`, `inbox`, `slack`, `androidpush`, `iospush`, `webpush`
has_channels_any.title: Has channels any

is_active.description: Set `true` for published templates, `false` for templates which are in draft. Do not pass this key to return all templates.
is_active.title: Is active

is_archived.description: Set `true` to get archived templates, default = `false`
is_archived.title: Is archived

limit.description: Number of tenants to return per page.
limit.title: Limit

parent_id.description: Returns only direct children of the given tenant.
parent_id.title: Parent id

ancestors_json.description: Returns all descendants (at any depth) of the given tenant. The tenant itself is not included. Repeat the param to pass multiple tenants.
ancestors_json.title: Ancestors

levels_json.description: Returns tenants at the given level(s). Root = 0, max = 4. Repeat the param to combine levels.
levels_json.title: Levels

limit.description: number of results to be returned in API response (max 100)
limit.title: Limit

after.description: cursor to fetch the next page (from `meta.after` of the previous response)
after.title: After

before.description: cursor to fetch the previous page (from `meta.before` of the previous response)
before.title: Before

tenant_id.description: Filter users associated with the given tenant. When set, each result includes the tenant-scoped `properties` and channel overrides applied for this user under that tenant.
tenant_id.title: Tenant id

created_at_gte.description: Optional RFC3339 lower bound for this monitored message window.
created_at_gte.title: Created at or after

list_id.description: Unique string identifier of the list to which user needs to be updated
list_id.title: List id

distinct_ids_json.description: Array of subscriber_ids, uniquely identifying the subscribers to be removed from the list.
distinct_ids_json.title: Distinct ids

distinct_id.description: distinct_id of recipient who should receive the notification
distinct_id.title: Distinct id

event.description: string identifier for the event like `product_purchased`
event.title: Event

properties_json.description: Properties are used to render template or workflow variables in the trigger.
properties_json.title: Properties

tenant_id.description: string identifier of the tenant this event is associated with
tenant_id.title: Tenant id

cancellation_key.description: Lookup key stored on each execution this event triggers, so a [Cancel Workflow](/docs/cancel-workflow) node can later stop them by matching on it. Pass a literal string (max 512 characters; longer values are truncated). Overrides a target workflow's own Trigger-node Cancellation Key expression when both are present.
cancellation_key.title: Cancellation key

workflow.description: You can get workflow slug from workflow settings on SuprSend dashboard.
workflow.title: Workflow

recipients_json.description: List of recipients to be notified. You can either add recipient as array of distinct_ids or array of recipient objects. You can add up to 100 recipients in a single API.
recipients_json.title: Recipients

actor_json.description: Includes distinct_id and properties of the user who performed the action. You can use it for [cross-user notifications]("https://docs.suprsend.com/docs/trigger-workflow#sending-cross-user-notifications"). Actor properties can be added as `$actor.<prop>`.
actor_json.title: Actor

data_json.description: variable data required to render dynamic template content or workflow properties like dynamic delay or channel override in send node.
data_json.title: Data

tenant_id.description: Tenant context for this trigger. Applies the tenant's branding, admin preferences, and vendor routing, and — for users with a [per-tenant profile](/docs/user-tenant-mapping) — resolves recipients against the merged (global + per-tenant) profile.
tenant_id.title: Tenant id

cancellation_key.description: Lookup key stored on the running execution so a [Cancel Workflow](/docs/cancel-workflow) node can later stop this run by matching on it. Pass a literal string (max 512 characters; longer values are truncated). When both this field and the target workflow's Trigger-node Cancellation Key JSONNET expression are present, this payload value wins.
cancellation_key.title: Cancellation key

list_id.description: ID of the list whose users you want to notify. Case-insensitive. The list must exist and be enabled.
list_id.title: List id

workflow.description: Slug of the workflow to trigger. The workflow must exist in the workspace.
workflow.title: Workflow

data_json.description: Variables used in the workflow and its templates, as `{{key}}`. The same `data` goes to every list member's run. Use `$recipient.<property>` in templates for per-user values.
data_json.title: Data

tenant_id.description: ID of the [tenant](/docs/tenants) the runs belong to. Its branding and preferences apply to every run. Defaults to `default`. The tenant must exist.
tenant_id.title: Tenant id

delay.description: Wait this long before triggering. Pass a duration string in the format `XXdXXhXXmXXs` (for example, `1h30m`) or a number of seconds (for example, `5400`). Maximum 15 days.
delay.title: Delay

trigger_at.description: Trigger at this date-time, in ISO 8601 format with a timezone (for example, `2026-11-05T09:30:00Z`). Maximum 15 days from now. If `trigger_at` is in the future, it wins over `delay`. If it's in the past, `delay` applies when set; otherwise the workflow triggers right away.
trigger_at.title: Trigger at

cancellation_key.description: Key stored on every run started by this trigger, so a [Cancel Workflow](/docs/cancel-workflow) node can stop those runs. This value overrides the workflow's Trigger-node cancellation key expression. To cancel the runs through the [Cancel Workflow API](/reference/cancel-workflow) instead, pass this request's `$idempotency_key` (or the `message_id` from the response) as `idempotency_key`.
cancellation_key.title: Cancellation key

idempotency_key.description: Unique key for this request, up to 255 characters. Another request with the same key within 24 hours is ignored, so retries don't notify the list twice.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency key

tenant_id.description: unique identifier of the tenant whose properties you want to update
tenant_id.title: Tenant id

payload_json.description: JSON object matching the documented Update Tenant Properties payload. Use either properties to replace all custom properties, or operations with $set / $unset.
payload_json.title: Payload

operations_json.description:
You can use the following operations to edit user profile.
- `$set` to add/update a property
- `$unset` to delete property/channel
- `$append` to insert values in property/channel array
- `$remove` to remove values from property/channel array
- `$set_once` to set immutable properties (only set if the property doesn't already exist)
- `$add` to increase/decrease integer values on further update
operations_json.title: Operations

distinct_id.description: distinct_id of the user whose preferences should be updated
distinct_id.title: Distinct id

tenant_id.description: to update user preferences for a particular tenant
tenant_id.title: Tenant id

channel_preferences_json.description: Use this to update channel level user preferences. Set `is_restricted - true` if the channel is opted_out by the user. This will only send critical notifications to the user which can't be opted out
channel_preferences_json.title: Channel preferences

categories_json.description: Use this to update user preference across categories and channels inside a category.
categories_json.title: Categories

tenant_id.description: Tenant identifier to create or update. Max 64 chars; allowed characters `[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]` (converted to lowercase unless case-sensitive IDs are enabled for your organization).
tenant_id.title: Tenant id

name.description: Tenant display name. Replaces the legacy `tenant_name` field; both are accepted.
name.title: Name

parent_id.description: ID of the parent tenant if you want to add this tenant as a sub-tenant. Skip this field, or pass `null` or `""` to create the tenant as a root. Setting it on an existing tenant re-parents it or leave it `null` to delink existing parent. Must reference an existing tenant. See [Sub-tenants](/docs/sub-tenants).
parent_id.title: Parent id

blocked_channels_json.description: Channels turned off for this tenant. Notifications on these channels won't be sent to any user of the tenant — including on [root categories](/docs/notification-category#root-categories) (which users normally can't unsubscribe from) — and users can't override this. If [sub-tenants](/docs/sub-tenants) are used, a block set here also applies to every sub-tenant below and can't be removed lower down. Allowed: `email`, `sms`, `whatsapp`, `androidpush`, `iospush`, `webpush`, `slack`, `ms_teams`, `inbox`.
blocked_channels_json.title: Blocked channels

primary_color.description: Primary brand color, used in the tenant's email header, buttons, and footer. If left empty when creating a root tenant, it's set to SuprSend's default (`#777777`).
primary_color.title: Primary color

secondary_color.description: Secondary brand color. Not part of the default tenant component but can be used in templates as `{{$tenant.secondary_color}}`. If both secondary and tertiary colors are left empty when creating a root tenant, they're copied from the default tenant.
secondary_color.title: Secondary color

tertiary_color.description: Tertiary brand color. Not part of the default tenant component but can be used in templates as `{{$tenant.tertiary_color}}`. If both secondary and tertiary colors are left empty when creating a root tenant, they're copied from the default tenant.
tertiary_color.title: Tertiary color

embedded_preference_url.description: URL of your product's preference page.
embedded_preference_url.title: Embedded preference url

social_links_json.description: Tenant's social media URLs. Pass `""` to clear a link (not `null`).
social_links_json.title: Social links

properties_json.description: Custom tenant properties. Merged per top-level key on update — keys not in the payload are kept as-is.
properties_json.title: Properties

distinct_id.description: Unique identifier of the user in your system
distinct_id.title: Distinct id

payload_json.description: JSON object matching the documented Create / Update Users payload. Use $email, $sms, $timezone and custom profile properties.
payload_json.title: Payload

credentials.description: Credentials for this node (optional if using environment variables)
